svg.text: The whole system: a replicated bank account over Java RMI
One Message Delivery server decides the order · every bank server is a full copy (replica) of the account · every replica runs the same transactions in the same order
"Head office": decides the order, holds no balance itself
new member list to every bank
started while the group is running
gets the whole state in one copy
"Branch": a full copy of the account
"the inbox": created here, not ordered yet
executes transactions in the server's order
